topic: Neural Network Learning: The Intuition Behind Backpropagation
target_audience: University students (Computer Science or Data Science beginners)

sections.title: The Analogy: Learning through Error
lecture_lines: Neural networks learn just like students.
We measure error using a Loss Function.
animations: Create a 'student' agent icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/student.svg] at center #FFFFFF.
Visualize feedback loop from error back to student [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/student.svg] #FFFF00.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Gradient Landscape
lecture_lines: Imagine navigating a mountain in the dark.
The gradient points to the steepest descent.
animations: Draw a complex 3D surface map in light blue #ADD8E6 representing a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/mountain.svg].
Highlight a 'starting point' on the surface #FFA500 using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/flashlight.svg].
Animate a path moving towards the lowest valley #00FF00.

sections.title: The Forward Pass: Data Propagation
lecture_lines: Inputs travel through layers of neurons.
Each weight influences the final output.
Data propagation creates a network prediction.
animations: Display a single neuron node using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/neuron.svg] #FFFFFF.
Draw arrows connecting multiple layers of [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/neuron.svg] nodes #FFFF00.
Show data flowing through [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/neuron.svg] layers from input to output #00FF00.
Highlight activation function transformation within the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/neuron.svg] #FF00FF.
Final output value appears at the end of the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/neuron.svg] chain #00FFFF.

sections.title: The Core: Backpropagation (Chain Rule Intuition)
lecture_lines: We use the Chain Rule for adjustments.
The network assigns blame to weights.
This chain reaction identifies key errors.
animations: Display chain of three gear symbols [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/gear.svg] #FFFFFF.
Show first gear [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/gear.svg] turning second gear #FFFF00.
Show second gear turning third gear #FF00FF.
Visualize total change as product of changes #00FF00.
Highlight final link back to first gear [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/gear.svg] #FF0000.

sections.title: The Update: Gradient Descent
lecture_lines: We nudge weights opposite the gradient.
This process is called Gradient Descent.
Learning rates control our step size.
animations: Represent weights as a set of adjustable sliders [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/slider.svg] #FFFFFF.
Move sliders [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/slider.svg] incrementally to reduce loss #00FF00.
